item.title: Caterer
item.author: jonas.mht.private@gmail.com (Jonas Mehtali)
item.description:
Description

Back in 2022, I was enrolled as a caterer for two consecutive years at the University of Strasbourg’s Service de la Vie Universitaire (SVU).

Mission

I was responsible for coordinating with my colleagues in the catering department to set up buffets, welcome guests, and ensure the smooth execution of events.

Conclusion

This experience allowed me to discover catering and to develop my skills in attention to detail, guest relations and communication.

item.title: Store Associate
item.author: jonas.mht.private@gmail.com (Jonas Mehtali)
item.description:
Description

Back in 2021, I was enrolled as a store associate in a convenient store for one year.
I was working part-time on weekends and during the holidays at the local convenient store of my hometown.

Mission

I was responsible for sales, stock management, supply trips, accounting, and order preparation.
I had to perform all these tasks simultaneously and efficiently as I was the only employee in the store during my shifts.

Conclusion

This experience allowed me to discover work as a store associate and to develop my skills in planning, accounting and punctuality.

item.title: Public Servant
item.author: jonas.mht.private@gmail.com (Jonas Mehtali)
item.description:
Description

Back in 2020, I was enrolled as a public servant in my hometown of Niffer for two consecutive years.
I was in charge of the surveillance of the recycling center, the maintenance of green spaces and the hauling and escorting of equipment.

Missions

Recycling Center : Surveillance and Maintenance

This mission consisted of receiving the users, keeping an eye out for proper sorting of the waste and maintaining the recycling center.

Maintenance of Green Spaces

On a daily basis, I was in charge of mowing the lawns, weeding the flower beds and watering the plants in various locations of the municipality.

Hauling and Escorting Equipment

I would drive various vehicles such as a tractor and a van for the purpose of hauling equipment on site and escorting large heavy-duty vehicles.

Conclusion

This experience allowed me to discover work as a public servant and to develop my skills in the field of teamwork, planning and versatile equipment use.
